14/S0.subgoal: Explain the concept and purpose of full-body tracking in VR.

14/S1.subgoal: Compare motion capture and camera-based approaches for full-body tracking.

14/S2.subgoal: Describe sound and voice tracking as non-hand input methods.

14/S3.subgoal: Explain the processing units and main components (GPU, CPU, RAM) in VR systems.

14/S4.subgoal: Describe the different categories of output devices.

14/S5.subgoal: Identify the three broad types of visual displays.

14/S6.subgoal: Explain the types and uses of head-mounted displays (HMDs).

14/S7.subgoal: Describe world-fixed displays and cave systems.

14/S8.subgoal: Describe regular displays like smartphones and tablets.

14/S9.subgoal: Explain audio output and spatial sound in VR.

14/S10.subgoal: Describe the different categories of haptic rendering systems.

14/S11.subgoal: Explain motion platforms and their role in physical motion simulation.

14/S12.subgoal: Describe treadmills and summarize the hardware components discussed in the lecture.
